The Abu Garcia Max X Spinning 750 (MAXXSP750) is a 750-size spinning reel suited to ultralight panfish, trout, and creek fishing. 6.4 oz, 21 inches of line pickup per handle turn, and 6.4 lb of published maximum drag define the working scale of this exact model. At 6.4 oz, it keeps trout and panfish outfits light in hand, while the 21-inch retrieve provides controlled line pickup.

Quick Answer: Best Line for the Abu Garcia Max X Spinning 750

Best overall range: 4-8 lb braid

Simple alternative: 2-6 lb mono/fluoro

For most anglers, start with 4-8 lb braid and add a 2-6 lb leader matched to the water and target species. A straightforward alternative is 2-6 lb mono/fluoro. Using more backing can reduce how much premium line you need.

That flexibility is useful when the same reel may see light presentations one day and stronger fish or mixed cover the next.

Quantum Drive 20 Line Capacity & Reel Setup Guide

The Quantum Drive 20 (DR20) falls in the 20-size class and is intended for trout, panfish, and light bass. 8.9 oz, 28 inches of line pickup per handle turn, and 10 lb of published maximum drag define the working scale of this exact model. A published maximum drag of 10 lb adds useful headroom for bass and walleye while the reel remains sized for lighter tackle.

Quick Answer: Best Line for the Quantum Drive 20

Best overall range: 8-15 lb braid

Simple alternative: 4-8 lb mono/fluoro

For most anglers, start with 8-15 lb braid and add a 4-8 lb leader matched to the water and target species. A straightforward alternative is 4-8 lb mono/fluoro. Using more backing can reduce how much premium line you need.

Open this exact reel in the Reel Setup Wizard.

Who Is the Quantum Drive 20 For?

This reel makes the most sense for anglers fishing trout, panfish, and light bass. Its published capacity gives you room to choose between a simple 4-8 lb mono/fluoro setup or a thinner 8-15 lb braid setup with a leader. That flexibility is useful when the same reel may see light presentations one day and stronger fish or mixed cover the next.
